deals.evidence: King became the Sky Bet Championship club's majority shareholder earlier this month when the EFL ratified his purchase of 85 per cent of the club.
deals.headline: Doug King buys 85% of Coventry City from SISU
deals.summary: The EFL ratified Doug King's purchase of 85% of the club in January 2023, making him majority owner and ending SISU's control; price not disclosed. King's vehicle CovCityCo Ltd was notified as the club's person with significant control on 10 January 2023.

deals.evidence: King purchased the remaining 15 per cent that was owned by SISU Capital Limited
deals.headline: Doug King buys SISU's remaining 15% of Coventry City
deals.summary: King bought the remaining 15% held by SISU Capital Limited, taking him to 100%; the company was renamed from Otium Entertainment Group Limited back to Coventry City Football Club Limited. Price not disclosed.

deals.evidence: During the year, the company issued 1,222,222 ordinary 'A' shares for a total consideration of £15,000,000.
deals.headline: RCMA Group subscribes £15m for 'A' shares in Coventry City's parent
deals.source_name: CovCityCo Ltd group accounts, year ended 31 May 2025 (Companies House)
deals.summary: CovCityCo Ltd, the club's parent, issued 1,222,222 ordinary 'A' shares for £15m (allotment dated 22 May 2025); the November 2025 confirmation statement names RCMA Group Pte Ltd as holder. The £15m was still owed by related parties at 31 May 2025.

deals.evidence: Coventry City owner Doug King has bought the CBS Arena from Mike Ashley's Frasers Group, finally bringing the stadium and the football club together after two decades.
deals.headline: Coventry City buys the CBS Arena from Frasers Group
deals.summary: The club's group bought the Coventry Building Society Arena, including its hotel and casino, from Mike Ashley's Frasers Group, ending 20 years as a tenant. Price not disclosed; Frasers had bought the arena businesses out of administration in November 2022.

notes: League corrected to Premier League: Coventry won the 2025/26 Championship and were promoted (premierleague.com, Yahoo Sports); the key still says efl-championship. Figures are the club company's own accounts for the year to 31 May 2025 (the latest filed; the PDF scan has no text layer, so the iXBRL version is cited). Group (CovCityCo Ltd) figures differ: group loss before tax £25.310M, group net debt £49,477,299 used for net_debt. Owner stakes: Companies House gives King 'Ownership of shares – 75% or more' of CovCityCo; the Nov 2025 confirmation statement lists King with 11,000,000 ordinary shares and RCMA Group Pte Ltd with 1,222,222 'A' shares (no percentage stated, so stake_pct left null). Press in Jan 2023 said King owned 100% before the RCMA allotment. Stadium price undisclosed. No valuation, chief executive, attendance (only part-season figures found) or social counts found on citable pages. Club site (ccfc.co.uk) is a JavaScript app whose pages cannot be read without a browser.
